description: Hierarchical category taxonomy for ProtoPart library. Parts declare explicit taxonomy paths in their metadata.taxonomy field. Nodes may carry optional documentation metadata (docs_url, links, agent_notes) and kit nodes carry a kit block that points at a manifest in contribution/kits/. Schema: category-taxonomy.schema.json.

arduino.name: Arduino
arduino.agent_notes: 5 V logic on classic AVR boards (Uno, Mega, Nano); 3.3 V on R4 Minima/WiFi, Due and Nano 33 families. Check board voltage before pairing with 3.3 V-only sensors.

raspberry_pi.name: Raspberry Pi
raspberry_pi.description: Raspberry Pi single-board computers and Pico
raspberry_pi.agent_notes: All Raspberry Pi GPIO is 3.3 V and not 5 V tolerant. Pico exposes 3.3 V GPIO with 3 ADC channels.

esp32.name: ESP32
esp32.agent_notes: 3.3 V logic, not 5 V tolerant. On classic ESP32, GPIO34-39 are input-only with no pull-ups; GPIO0/2/12/15 are strapping pins; ADC2 is unavailable while Wi-Fi is active.

freenove_fnk0082.name: Freenove Ultimate Starter Kit for ESP32-S3 (FNK0082)
freenove_fnk0082.description: Freenove ESP32-S3-WROOM starter kit with breadboard, GPIO extension board, camera, sensors, displays, motors and discretes. Used in intro electrical engineering design classes.
freenove_fnk0082.agent_notes: This is the Freenove kit to use when a user asks for 'the Freenove kit' / 'Freenove ESP32 kit'. Controller is the Freenove ESP32-S3-WROOM board (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N8R8, 3.3 V logic, no DAC; GPIO35-37 are taken by octal PSRAM; the camera connector and microSD slot share some GPIOs), mounted on the GPIO extension board over an 830-point breadboard. Audio output uses PWM or the I2S audio module, not a DAC. The 7-segment displays, LED matrix and RGB LED are common anode. No Wi-Fi/BLE parts are needed beyond the board itself.
